gbm_population_evidence.quote: Diagnosis of recurrent or progressive glioblastoma (as defined in 2021 World Health Organization \[WHO\] Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System; Louis, Perry, et al. 2021) for which resection is not indicated as assessed by the study physician

candidate_evidence.quote: Sonodynamic therapy is a non-invasive combination therapy that uses low-intensity ultrasound, such as MRgFUS, to activate a drug, such as SONALA-001 or 5-ALA HCL, to kill tumor cells.

role_evidence.quote: This early phase I trial tests the safety, best dose, and effectiveness of SONALA-001 or 5-ALA HCL in combination with magnetic resonance imaging-guided focused ultrasound (MRgFUS), also called sonodynamic therapy, in treating patients with glioblastoma

agents.drug_class_hint: intravenous 5-aminolevulinic acid formulation used as sonosensitiser
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: uses low-intensity ultrasound, such as MRgFUS, to activate a drug, such as SONALA-001 or 5-ALA HCL, to kill tumor cells

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive SONALA-001 IV over 15 minutes or 5-ALA HCL PO and undergo transcranial MRgFUS 3-8 hours after infusion on day 1 of each cycle.

agents.drug_class_hint: oral 5-aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride used as sonosensitiser
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: uses low-intensity ultrasound, such as MRgFUS, to activate a drug, such as SONALA-001 or 5-ALA HCL, to kill tumor cells

coder_notes: Registered EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). Sonodynamic therapy: aminolevulinic acid candidate with device_dependent true; MRgFUS is a device and not listed. The two ALA formulations are alternatives within one arm, so each is coded experimental_monotherapy. Blood sampling mentioned only as 'blood sample collection', not as PK.
